policy: A check moves a score only when it is listed here: a measurable condition (pass and fail stated), backed by a published standard (kind 'standard', exact passage verified against the source) or by documented Avara guidance (kind 'avara-guidance', the condition and where it is documented), with saved evidence, and a failing and a clean fixture that test/score-admission.mjs runs through the real scanner and rule engine with AI off. The result that counts is the measured one, never an AI opinion. The definition hash pins the rule text: any edit invalidates the admission until it is re-verified.

source.name: Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) 2.2
source.method: Passage text compared with the success-criterion paragraph fetched from the URL above.

passages.text: The visual presentation of text and images of text has a contrast ratio of at least 4.5:1, except for the following:
All non-text content that is presented to the user has a text alternative that serves the equivalent purpose, except for the situations listed below.
Information, structure, and relationships conveyed through presentation can be programmatically determined or are available in text.
Labels or instructions are provided when content requires user input.

For all user interface components (including but not limited to: form elements, links and components generated by scripts), the name and role can be programmatically determined; states, properties, and values that can be set by the user can be programmatically set; and notification of changes to these items is available to user agents, including assistive technologies.
For user interface components with labels that include text or images of text, the name contains the text that is presented visually.

condition.pass: Every control works by keyboard and focus can leave.
condition.fail: A control is unreachable by keyboard, or focus is trapped.

guidance.documentedIn: src/detectors/detector-specs.json (A11Y-004) and src/rules (A11Y-004: SC 2.1.1 and 2.1.2. Exercise relevant keys and outcome. A bounded Tab trace alone cannot establish failure.)

passages.text: Any keyboard operable user interface has a mode of operation where the keyboard focus indicator is visible.
Information, structure, and relationships conveyed through presentation can be programmatically determined or are available in text.

The purpose of each link can be determined from the link text alone or from the link text together with its programmatically determined link context, except where the purpose of the link would be ambiguous to users in general.

For all user interface components (including but not limited to: form elements, links and components generated by scripts), the name and role can be programmatically determined; states, properties, and values that can be set by the user can be programmatically set; and notification of changes to these items is available to user agents, including assistive technologies.
Except for captions and images of text, text can be resized without assistive technology up to 200 percent without loss of content or functionality.
Content can be presented without loss of information or functionality, and without requiring scrolling in two dimensions for:
Information, structure, and relationships conveyed through presentation can be programmatically determined or are available in text.

For all user interface components (including but not limited to: form elements, links and components generated by scripts), the name and role can be programmatically determined; states, properties, and values that can be set by the user can be programmatically set; and notification of changes to these items is available to user agents, including assistive technologies.

condition.pass: Bypass, order and consistent navigation hold.
condition.fail: No bypass, or focus order breaks meaning.

guidance.documentedIn: src/detectors/detector-specs.json (A11Y-019) and src/rules (A11Y-019: Assess bypass mechanisms, focus order, and consistent navigation under 2.4.1, 2.4.3, 3.2.3 as applicable.)

passages.text: Color is not used as the only visual means of conveying information, indicating an action, prompting a response, or distinguishing a visual element.

condition.pass: The entry point is available in the intended state.
condition.fail: Hidden, covered or unreachable.

guidance.documentedIn: src/detectors/detector-specs.json (CONV-002) and src/rules (CONV-002: Test availability of the conversion entry point in the intended state; use MOB-010 for the same mobile observation.)

condition.pass: Hierarchy of heading, support and action is clear.
condition.fail: Emphasis is inverted.

guidance.documentedIn: src/detectors/detector-specs.json (DESIGN-001) and src/rules (DESIGN-001: Compare heading, supporting text and action emphasis within one task.)

reference.source: Refactoring UI, labels are a last resort

condition.pass: Fewer than 4 of the 7 template sections match in order.
condition.fail: 5 or more of the 7 match in order.

guidance.documentedIn: src/detectors/detector-specs.json (DIFF-001) and src/rules (DIFF-001: The order of the page's sections matches the common AI-SaaS landing template: Hero, Feature grid, Logo cloud, Testimonials, Pricing, FAQ, Call-to-action band. O)

reference.source: Avara editorial pattern (AI SaaS landing template); reference: NN/g Homepage Design Principles

condition.pass: Page is no wider than 320px (+1), or overflow is only in exempt content.
condition.fail: The page needs sideways scrolling and names the causing element.

guidance.documentedIn: src/detectors/detector-specs.json (MOB-002) and src/rules (MOB-002: Locate causal element at 320 CSS px. Apply SC 1.4.10 exceptions including two-dimensional content.)

condition.pass: Target is at least 24 by 24 CSS px or meets a spacing/inline exception.
condition.fail: Target is under 24 CSS px without an exception.

guidance.documentedIn: src/detectors/detector-specs.json (MOB-003) and src/rules (MOB-003: Measure target and neighbours. Apply SC 2.5.8 exceptions, including spacing.)

condition.pass: No content or controls lost at 200% text and with text-spacing overrides.
condition.fail: Content or a control is clipped or overlaps.

guidance.documentedIn: src/detectors/detector-specs.json (MOB-006) and src/rules (MOB-006: At increased text size, check for lost content or controls under SC 1.4.4; also test text-spacing overrides under 1.4.12.)

condition.pass: Images fit, keep proportions and do not overflow.
condition.fail: An image is distorted, crops meaningful content or overflows.

guidance.documentedIn: src/detectors/detector-specs.json (MOB-007) and src/rules (MOB-007: Compare rendered image bounds at widths; identify distortion, cropping of meaningful content or overflow.)

condition.pass: Menu opens, works by keyboard and returns focus.
condition.fail: Menu cannot be operated by keyboard or traps focus.

guidance.documentedIn: src/detectors/detector-specs.json (MOB-008) and src/rules (MOB-008: Exercise the mobile menu, keyboard interaction, and return path. Apply pattern guidance to the actual widget.)

condition.pass: Inputs use suitable types and local validation guides the visitor.
condition.fail: Input types or validation hinder mobile entry.

guidance.documentedIn: src/detectors/detector-specs.json (MOB-009) and src/rules (MOB-009: Trace input, local validation, and field navigation at the mobile viewport.)

condition.pass: The action is on screen, uncovered, large enough and activates.
condition.fail: It is clipped, covered, off screen or does not activate.

guidance.documentedIn: src/detectors/detector-specs.json (MOB-010) and src/rules (MOB-010: Record visibility, occlusion, reachability, and activation of the primary action on mobile.)

condition.pass: Layout adapts without loss under resize and orientation change.
condition.fail: Content or function is lost on resize or rotation.

guidance.documentedIn: src/detectors/detector-specs.json (MOB-011) and src/rules (MOB-011: Inspect effective layout under resize/orientation; use SC 1.3.4 or 1.4.10 only when applicable.)

condition.pass: Nothing fixed or sticky covers the action.
condition.fail: A fixed or sticky element covers the action at 320px.

guidance.documentedIn: src/detectors/detector-specs.json (MOB-013) and src/rules (MOB-013: Measure overlap and exercise the control. Apply SC 2.4.11 only if author content entirely hides keyboard focus.)

condition.pass: The opening contains a descriptor of what the product does or is for.
condition.fail: No h1 on the page.

guidance.documentedIn: src/detectors/detector-specs.json (PC-001) and src/rules (PC-001: Within the first screen a newcomer can tell what the product is. Objective check: the opening (the h1 plus the line under it) contains a descriptor of what the )

condition.pass: The h1 has 4 to 14 words.
condition.fail: The h1 has over 24 or under 2 words.

guidance.documentedIn: src/detectors/detector-specs.json (PC-005) and src/rules (PC-005: The headline is a usable length. Objective check: the h1 has 4 to 14 words; 15 to 24 needs a person; over 24 or under 2 fails.)

condition.pass: The supporting line has 8 to 35 words and is not a restatement.
condition.fail: Overlap with the h1 is 70% or more.

guidance.documentedIn: src/detectors/detector-specs.json (PC-006) and src/rules (PC-006: When a subheadline exists it adds information. Objective check: 8 to 35 words, and not a restatement of the h1 (word overlap under 70%).)

condition.pass: Heading and supporting line are in the first screen with 15 or more words.
condition.fail: The h1 starts below the first screen.

guidance.documentedIn: src/detectors/detector-specs.json (PC-010) and src/rules (PC-010: The first screen on its own explains the offer. Objective check: the h1 is inside the first screen, and so is a supporting line, with at least 15 words of text )

condition.pass: No call to action above the h1.
condition.fail: A call to action sits above the h1.

guidance.documentedIn: src/detectors/detector-specs.json (PC-011) and src/rules (PC-011: The offer is stated before the page asks for action. Objective check: no call to action sits above the h1 in the first screen.)

condition.pass: Claims of the same kind agree within 10%.
condition.fail: Two values for the same kind of claim differ by more than 10%.

guidance.documentedIn: src/detectors/detector-specs.json (PC-013) and src/rules (PC-013: The page does not contradict itself about the offer. Objective check: the same kind of numeric claim (customers, users, teams, reviews) is stated with two diffe)

condition.pass: Lab LCP is 2.5 s or less.
condition.fail: Lab LCP is over 2.5 s (poor over 4 s).

guidance.documentedIn: src/detectors/detector-specs.json (PERF-001) and src/rules (PERF-001: Record lab/field source, value, conditions and LCP element when available.)

condition.pass: The slowest measured lab interaction is 200 ms or less (labelled lab, not field p75).
condition.fail: A measured lab interaction took over 200 ms.

guidance.documentedIn: src/detectors/detector-specs.json (PERF-003) and src/rules (PERF-003: Use appropriate interaction evidence; for field assessment record p75, device and scope. Never substitute TBT.)

condition.pass: No evidenced image opportunity.
condition.fail: A traced image has a measured saving.

guidance.documentedIn: src/detectors/detector-specs.json (PERF-004) and src/rules (PERF-004: Trace a specific image, transferred size, rendered size and evidenced opportunity.)

condition.pass: Fonts do not delay text or shift layout.
condition.fail: A font causes measured delay or shift.

guidance.documentedIn: src/detectors/detector-specs.json (PERF-005) and src/rules (PERF-005: Trace a specific font request and measured delay, invisible text or layout shift.)

condition.pass: No script with measured cost.
condition.fail: A script has measured execution or unused payload.

guidance.documentedIn: src/detectors/detector-specs.json (PERF-006) and src/rules (PERF-006: Tie a script to measured execution cost or unused payload under the tested interaction.)

condition.pass: No render-blocking resource of note.
condition.fail: A resource blocks first paint.

guidance.documentedIn: src/detectors/detector-specs.json (PERF-008) and src/rules (PERF-008: Show the resource, critical path and rendering consequence.)

condition.pass: Third parties cost little.
condition.fail: An origin has measured cost.

guidance.documentedIn: src/detectors/detector-specs.json (PERF-009) and src/rules (PERF-009: Identify origin and observed main-thread or network cost; compare equivalent runs if claiming improvement.)

condition.pass: A privacy link exists and resolves.
condition.fail: Personal data is requested and the link is missing or broken.

guidance.documentedIn: src/detectors/detector-specs.json (TRUST-002) and src/rules (TRUST-002: Where personal information is requested, inspect the disclosure link and observed destination. Record availability only.)

condition.pass: Terms are accessible before commitment.
condition.fail: Terms are referenced but unreachable.

guidance.documentedIn: src/detectors/detector-specs.json (TRUST-003) and src/rules (TRUST-003: When terms are referenced or owner-required, inspect access before commitment. Legal applicability requires separate review.)

condition.pass: The entry point is visible and uncovered in the first screen.
condition.fail: The entry point is hidden, covered or below a long scroll.

guidance.documentedIn: src/detectors/detector-specs.json (UX-002) and src/rules (UX-002: Locate the entry point to the confirmed visitor task.)

condition.pass: A visible or announced change follows the action within the time limit.
condition.fail: Nothing visible or announced changes.

guidance.documentedIn: src/detectors/detector-specs.json (UX-011) and src/rules (UX-011: Capture before/action/after, including selected, pending, and completed states.)

condition.pass: Back, dismiss and revise return the visitor safely.
condition.fail: A path loses input or traps the visitor.

guidance.documentedIn: src/detectors/detector-specs.json (UX-014) and src/rules (UX-014: Trace safe transitions, back paths, revisions and dismissals. Record last observed state.)
